claims.summary: In any degree-D binary Boolean pseudoideal, a surviving weight w0 of degree b admits simultaneous normalization of M prescribed old-affine complete helpers: if 1<=K<=v, t>=1, b+K+t+1<=D and M(1-eta)^t<1 for eta=N_v(K-1)/(2N_v(K)), there are constant binary rows and f of degree<=K with w0 f surviving and all weighted helper companions zero; accuracies may be zero-padded beyond t. Earlier w0 E memberships persist when deg(w0 E)+K<=D.
claims.assessment: Recovered single-branch removal application, not same-degree mixed-interface conservativity. Polynomial affine helper inventories cost logarithmic rows at linear cutoff with reserve; original replay and non-affine helpers remain separate.
claims.rationale: Useful scope clarification of an existing engine; no independent novelty or goal advance claimed.
claims.next_action: Test quantitative original-image bounds with the helper normalization paid.

claims.summary: Over the binary Boolean algebra with r core and m>=2 free coordinates, weight PH, unit tuple, U=V_K, 0<=K<m, the length-one image of the core feature alone has dimension N_m(K). Adding its x1,x2,x1+x2 pencil extensions raises this to N_m(K)+binom(m-1,K)+binom(m-2,K), although their sum is PH. The comparison embeds in a proper hard Boolean degree-D quotient with active unsatisfiable width u when D>=max(u,4(r+m+1)), on a selected coordinate multiplier subspace.
claims.assessment: Exact all-parameter monomial count and restriction-cube embedding. Unit tuple is a calibration, not a hard ENS parent. Does not exclude a sharper upper bound from a completed representation.
claims.rationale: Rules out automatic image saving inferred from helper redundancy; no source-wide lower bound or novelty claim.
claims.next_action: Compare completed and original quantitative image bounds, including enlargement.
